purpose: Teach: 糾弾/処刑/違憲/静止/議定/挑発/飢え/騎手

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、SNSでの糾弾に冷静対応しろ
lines.en: Handle the social media outcry with calm judgment.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Clipped tempo on key phrases. Each sentence lands as instruction, not suggestion. Steady eye contact. No inflection that invites debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違法商品は処刑対象でなく、即回収します
lines.en: Yes. We'll pull any suspect products immediately—not escalate.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Slight emphasis on the distinction between 'pull' and 'escalate.' Professional, precise. Not rushed. Reassuring through competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、違憲性の疑いある契約は破棄しろ
lines.en: And terminate any contracts with constitutional red flags.
lines.style: Same steady authority. 'Terminate' lands with quiet finality. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シャッターが静止するまで防犯カメラ点検します
lines.en: Understood. We'll check every angle of security footage until the shutters lock.
lines.style: Slightly technical in register. Small nod of competence. 'Every angle' and 'until' show thoroughness—not rushing past details. Quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界議定にも参加しろ
lines.en: And join the industry talks on this.
lines.style: Same authoritative tone, slightly softer. 'Join' is collaborative without being uncertain. Expects immediate agreement. Brief.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合の挑発的広告に動じません
lines.en: Yes. We won't flinch at competitor provocation in their ads.
lines.style: Quiet confidence on 'won't flinch.' Professional, unshaken. The tone of someone stating fact, not hoping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 途上国での飢え対策にも CSR で取り組め
lines.en: Also lead with CSR on hunger relief in developing markets.
lines.style: Slight shift to values-driven tone. Still authoritative, but broader—this one matters beyond the room. 'Lead with' carries weight. Pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。CMに騎手をモデルにする案、検討中です
lines.en: Yes. We're actually looking at featuring an equestrian as the face of the next campaign.
lines.style: Upbeat confirmation. 'Actually' signals he's had this in motion already. Slight pride in the detail. Conversational while still professional. Closes the briefing with momentum.
